{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.56

|gr1= Eden Editor

|descr= Sets the grid increment for the given transformation type.

|s1= [[set3DENGrid]] [type, value]

|p1= type: [[String]] - name of transformation type. Can be:
* {{hl|"r"}} - Rotation
* {{hl|"t"}} - Translation
* {{hl|"s"}} - Scale

|p2= value: [[Number]] - transformation increment

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>set3DENGrid ["t", 100]; // 100m movement increment</sqf>

|seealso= [[get3DENGrid]]
}}
